name: Unit
text: One row per top-level item a framework names (principle, pillar, risk or practice), with its own description. Sub-clauses are not separate items.

name: Meaning over label
text: Code what the item asks for, not the word it uses.

name: Risks
text: A risk is coded to the dimension that addresses it.

name: Practices
text: A practice is coded to what it ensures.

name: Several codes, one primary
text: An item may get several dimensions, but exactly one is primary.

name: Strength
text: Named: the item itself is about the dimension (its label or its main point). Mentioned: the dimension appears only within the item's description. Counted separately.

name: Other
text: Use OTH with a note when nothing fits. Three or more frameworks sharing a theme creates a new dimension.

name: When unsure
text: Write the doubt in the note. Do not guess silently.

name: Ambiguous words
text: A word that plausibly points to more than one dimension gets each of them, as Mentioned. Example: Australia "protection" in Test and monitor: SEC and SAF, both Mentioned.

name: Stated goals
text: If an item's description states a dimension as a goal ("Ensure X and Y"), each dimension stated is Named. Example: Australia "Ensure appropriate transparency and explainability": TRA and EXP both Named.
